notes.title: Elly Update 2.0.1
notes.content:
Elly Update 2.0.1

INVENTORY OVERHAUL

Inventory now shows stats for :

Player Level
Max Health
Max Stamina
Exp Needed
Current Exp Held
Melee DMG
EllyCoins Holding

Elly's Journal Entries Have been scattered among the bosses

11 new weapons with status effects added to the game - Chance to Poison/Freeze and Fire/Lightning/Ice +DMG added to certain weapons

Weapons now have flavor text and are shown in the Inventory

Inventory Expanded and weapons are select-able/equip-able 

You can now hot swap between gun/ray gun once unlocked in the inventory

Dash/jump potions are now collectables and stack-able in the inventory - used now in inventory by selecting

Enemies are now weak to status effects and a indicator will show when effected next to enemy health bar

Menu cleanups

Down melee attack added

Weapon projectiles added

Wall jumps refined

Test Items : Teleporter/New seeking enemies/and water mechanics added in new area

notes.title: Elly Update 1.1 : Overview
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Internally Cleaned Code
[*] Added Stamina Cost to Shield Use And Stamina Drain While Active
[*] Can No Longer Shoot/Melee/Use BigBoi While Shielding
[*] Reworked Internal Sword System
[*] Added Two More Collectable Swords
[*] CheckPoints Now Top Off Player's Health
[*] Enemy Particle Death Effect Has Been Shortened
[*] Pressing LeftShift Or Back On Controller Now Opens An Inventory With Collected Swords To Equip
[*] Inventory Now Saves As Intended
[*] Player Dialogue Choice Now Has A Timer
[*] Option A Will Be Auto Chosen If Time Runs Out
[*] Settings Menu Now Shows How To Interact With NPC's With Mouse
[*] Added Inventory To Controller Button Layout
[*] Added Are You Sure You Want To Start New Game Panel
[/list]

New Weapons With Unique Abilities - Coming Soon! (10 New Weapons Planned!)
Elly's Journal Pages - Coming Soon! (Uncover New Lore!)
Controller Mapping - Coming Soon! (Working Hard On This!)
New Area With New Npc's To Talk To - Coming Soon! (Free New Large Area To Explore!)
